text:
Brandt Clarke is having the season the Kings hoped for when they drafted him eighth overall: 11 points in 16 games, and Los Angeles takes 59% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, nearly 15 points better than without him. NHL.com quoted him as "happy to be a key contributor."

He's been unlucky, too. The Kings have scored 6.8 fewer goals than expected with him on, which has cost him points. His own shooting is high (11.5% on very few chances), so the goals may slow, but the assists should pick up.

Last season's numbers back it up. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 91st percentile for driving offense among defensemen, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile for setups and stopping 16% of the entries aimed at him. Our range: 35 to 54 points.
